scope: Additive TH18 regular Miner direct-parent and source-bounded tunnel baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3; the immutable raw parent table matches L1-L12 HP/DPS/cost/time/TH values but differs on range.

sources.title: Miner
sources.limitations: Reports matching L1-L12 HP/DPS table, housing 6, speed 32, ground target, cadence 1.7 seconds, tunnelling beneath walls and untargetability while moving. It does not publish tunnel/surface duration, spawn position, target ties, trap timing, collision, underground effect eligibility or fixed-tick ordering; its 0.6 range conflicts with the pinned raw record's 0.5.

sources.title: Full Release Notes
sources.limitations: Officially confirms Poison is not applied to Miners while underground, but publishes neither current numeric values nor a complete tunnel/trap/contact contract.

sources.title: Home Village Miner structured troop record
sources.limitations: Supplies matching L1-L12 parent values, speed, 1.7-second cadence and 0.5 range, but no current build identity or deterministic tunnel lifecycle.

support.note: Core materializes the existing immutable L1-L12 ground direct parent and its generic underground route/state through the same BattleState used by Headless, Viewer and RL.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L1-L12 parent despite existing generic Core underground travel, snapshot and trap guards.
changed_values.replacement: The parent and source-bounded tunnel baseline are classified as executable through shared Core paths with focused snapshot, replay, determinism and Headless coverage.
changed_values.justification: Sources support wall-bypass and underground untargetability qualitatively, but no undocumented duration or transition is introduced.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines tunnel/surface duration, initial or subsequent underground transition, target ties, route choice, emergence position, collision, attack wind-up, trap ordering, spell/effect eligibility other than Poison, or same-tick ordering.

The build-pinned secondary source reports range 0.6 while the immutable structured source reports 0.5. The existing 0.5 Core value is retained pending corroboration; neither value is presented as primary-current.
No source provides current asset verification, underground animation timing or proof that Core's direct interpolation matches client movement.
conclusion: Miner L1-L12 is executable as a source-bounded ground direct parent through Core, Headless CLI, Viewer and RL. Its generic underground state bypasses Walls and ignores trap damage while travelling; timing, emergence, interactions, range conflict and visual fidelity remain partial.
